description.value: Circle K is a 24/7 convenience store and petrol station in Vancouver's Fairview neighbourhood, part of the global Circle K/Couche-Tard chain. It offers standard convenience-store goods alongside hot prepared foods including roller grill items and fresh coffee. Its around-the-clock hours make it a reliable resupply stop for cyclists at any point in the day or night.
